defindex_vault_params.fee_note: vault_fee is a share of the GAINS (never of principal). 100 bps = 1% of yield is locked in the vault report and excluded from get_asset_amounts_per_shares (so from Lotus vault_value); 2000 bps (set by the factory) of that locked fee goes to the DeFindex protocol receiver GDOFDSMF..., the rest to defindex_fee_receiver. The protocol receiver has NO USDC trustline on testnet, so rebalance / rescue / distribute_fees revert once a locked fee > 0 exists. After the fee-netting measurements the manager set the fee to 0 (lock_fees(Some(0)), tx 2280d2e4...) and released the 291 stroops that had been locked (release_fees, tx bdd32307...).

observed_apr.summary: Blend USDC supply rate 6.91% APR (gross, whole pool); Lotus holders net 6.85% with the 1% vault fee (window A) and 6.91% with the fee at 0 (window B). Same reading as Blend's own rate model at the pool's 88.7% utilization.
observed_apr.measured_on: 2026-10-25 (ledgers 5387707 to 5388112, 34 minutes of sampling, two windows of 16.5 and 15 minutes)
method: A sampler simulated, every 45 s (9 ledgers) and in parallel on the same ledger (46 of 46 samples had no ledger skew): Blend pool get_reserve(USDC) -> data.b_rate (1e12 scale) and data.last_time (the ledger close time the interest is accrued to); Lotus vault_value(), surplus(), supply(); DeFindex fetch_total_managed_funds, report, total_supply, balance(lotus), get_asset_amounts_per_shares; strategy balance(vault).

Gross APR = (b_rate_end / b_rate_start - 1) * 31,536,000 / (t_end - t_start) with t = last_time. It is the rate every supplier of the Blend pool gets, independent of our deposits. get_reserve re-accrues to the current ledger on each call, so no pool interaction is needed to see it move.

Net APR (what Lotus holders earn) = growth of Lotus' price per DeFindex share, vault_value() / df_shares, annualized the same way. Deposits, redeems and distribute() do not move that price (up to 1 stroop of rounding), so it is valid across the events inside the windows (2 deposits, 2 redeems and 2 distribute calls of ours, plus a 1 USDC deposit/redeem by another agent's account, happened during the sampling).

Window A ran with vault_fee = 100 bps and ended just before lock_fees(0); window B starts after release_fees (the 291 stroops locked fee returned to depositors, a one-off step up that is excluded from both windows).
assumptions: year = 365 days = 31,536,000 s; simple (non-compounded) annualization of a 15 to 17 minute window; the rate is a snapshot of testnet pool conditions, not a forecast.
Fee model: vault_fee is a share of gains only. net/gross should equal 1 - fee_bps/10000.
observed_apr.rate_model_crosscheck: Blend v2 rate model with the pool's USDC reserve config (r_base 0.05%, r_one 3%, r_two 10%, target util 70%, max util 95%, ir_mod 0.8245, backstop take 10%): utilization 88.7% -> borrow APR 8.67% -> supply APR = 8.67% * 0.887 * 0.9 = 6.93%, against 6.937% measured over the first 45 s interval and 6.914% over the full windows.
observed_apr.noise: Net figures are quantized by 1 stroop of vault_value (about 1.5e9 stroops): +/-1 stroop = +/-0.0064% APR over window A (position 5e8 stroops at its end) and +/-0.0023% over window B. The observed gap to the fee-adjusted expectation (window A: 6.8487 vs 6.9139 * 0.99 = 6.8448; window B: 6.9099 vs 6.9141) is 0.6 stroop (A) and 1.8 stroops (B), i.e. rounding. Interval-to-interval spread of the gross rate: stdev 0.012 pts (A) and 0.007 pts (B), range 6.906 to 6.938.
caveats: The rate comes from other testnet users: the pool runs at 88.7% utilization (target 70%, max 95%). If borrowers repay, the supply APR falls (model: about 1.6% at 70% utilization); if utilization nears 95% withdrawals can revert on Blend's utilization cap. Read the live rate from chain (b_rate over two reads) instead of hard-coding it.
BLND emission rewards are not counted: the Blend strategy only compounds them when its keeper (a PaltaLabs key) calls harvest.
The Blend strategy is shared with other DeFindex vaults: it held about 68,000 USDC in total at the time, of which 1,150 USDC are ours. Our share price follows the shared strategy.
Absolute amounts are small on purpose (100 USDC earns about 0.019 USDC per day at 6.9%): the observation is the live accrual and the on-chain surplus -> distribute -> mint loop, not the size.
observed_apr.fee_netting_check: All 46 same-ledger samples: Lotus vault_value() == floor(net_total * lotus_df_shares / df_total_supply) + lotus_idle_usdc (1 stroop of dust), with net_total = strategy_balance - locked_fee - floor(pending_gain * fee_bps / 10000) (fee_bps 100 until lock_fees(0), 0 after); difference 0 stroops on every sample. fetch_total_managed_funds only subtracts the locked part.

notes: Second Lotus instance (same wasm as v1) on OUR OWN DeFindex vault 'Lotus USDC Blend' (LUSDCB), created through the DeFindex factory with fresh keys as manager / rebalance manager / emergency manager (defindex_vault_manager) and fee receiver. Why: on the PaltaLabs vault used by v1 the Blend strategy allocation is 0 and deposit(invest=true) invests only proportionally to the existing allocation, so it stays idle; seeding needs a rebalance Invest by the vault's rebalance manager, which we do not control. Here the manager deposited 1000 USDC (invest=false) and called rebalance([Invest(strategy, 1000 USDC)]) once; since then every deposit(invest=true), including Lotus', goes into the Blend pool. Receipt lUSDCb is a new classic asset (issuer GC7QBZD2...) whose SAC admin is this contract; v1's lUSDC SAC is locked to the v1 contract. Vault fee was created at 100 bps (1% of gains) and set to 0 after the netting measurements because the DeFindex protocol fee receiver (GDOFDSMF..., PaltaLabs) has no USDC trustline on testnet, which makes rebalance / rescue / distribute_fees revert as soon as a locked fee exists (deposit / withdraw, hence Lotus, are unaffected). Blend-touching calls cost 0.0015 to 0.14 XLM here (the '~90-100 XLM' figure of v1 was not reproduced). Views vault_value() / surplus() must be simulated (--send=no): DeFindex updates its fee report inside get_asset_amounts_per_shares, so they carry a 1-entry write footprint. Dust: deposit of 1 stroop reverts with DeFindex error #117 (0 shares), 2 stroops and up work. Secrets of every key named here are in deployments/testnet.strategies.secrets.json (gitignored). See deployments/README.md.
